blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – It is inconclusive to claim that a vessel carrying more than a ton of shabu (methamphetamine) intercepted by Thai authorities was headed to the Philippines. This statement comes from Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) chief Isanagi Nerez on Thursday, dispelling reports linking the cargo to domestic shores. Thai authorities intercepted a vessel bound for the Philippines carrying 1,178 kilograms of shabu in the Gulf of Thailand and arrested six Thai crew members operating the boat linked to an international drug trafficking syndicate, according to an Oct. 8 Bangkok Post report.
